4. Scroll down to the "Connecting on Facebook" section and click on "View Settings."
5. Scroll down to the "See Your Friend List" section and click on the drop-down menu to the right.
6. Select "Customize" from the drop-down menu.
7. In the resulting window, select "Only Me" from the drop-down menu next to the "These People" option.
8. Click "Save Setting" to make your friends list invisible.

Alternatively, you can also block individual friends by adding them to your block list. To do this:

1. Click on the "Account" tab in the top right corner.
2. Select "Privacy Settings" from the drop-down menu.
3. Under "Block Lists" at the bottom center of the page, click "Edit Your Lists."
4. At the top, under "Block Users," add the name or email address of the person you'd like to block.
5. Click "Block."
